architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context if needed). Static assets in public/. Build: Vite. Lint: ESLint + Prettier. Test: Vitest (minimal).

tickets.title: Landing page (sugi.dev_landing_page_integrated) to React component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Extract hero section, marquee, CTA buttons. Keep exact styling. Use CSS modules. Responsive breakpoints match design.

tickets.title: Portfolio home (sugi.dev_portfolio_home_final) to React component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract project grid, filter tabs, pagination. Use CSS Grid for layout. Static data for now (API later).

tickets.title: Work/Dev page (sugi.dev_work_final) to React component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract timeline, skill badges, project cards. Use flexbox for timeline. Static data.

tickets.title: About page (sugi.dev_about_page) to React component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract bio text, stats, marquee. Use CSS modules. Static content.

tickets.title: Services page (services_sugi.dev) to React component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract service cards, pricing table, CTA. Use CSS Grid for cards. Static data.

tickets.title: Contact & Inquiry pages to React components
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract forms, input fields, submit buttons. Use HTML5 validation. No backend (formspree or similar later).

tickets.title: Shared components (buttons, badges, footer) to React components
tickets.description: Extract reusable components. Buttons: primary/secondary variants. Badges: size/color variants. Footer: links, social icons. Use CSS modules. Props for variants.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Add navigation bar (match design). Set up React Router v6. Routes: /, /portfolio, /work, /about, /services, /contact, /inquiry. Lazy load pages. 404 page. Dark/light mode toggle (static for now).
